basis.name: Flowering plants · orders + outgroups
basis.question: What relationships among five sampled flowering-plant orders and one represented gymnosperm outgroup can this source support?
basis.edgeMeaning: Inferred evolutionary relationships from the source authors; drawing depth is nonmetric unless separately declared with evidence.
basis.evidenceBasis: Kew release 4.0 phylogenomic species-tree topology. These are the authors’ supplied species, family and order trees, not an inferred classification hierarchy. No source branch lengths are supplied.
basis.limitations: Sampling is incomplete and this is one inferred hypothesis. Gymnosperm outgroups are included. Numeric internal labels are retained without interpreting their support type. Drawing depth has no time or evolutionary-distance meaning.

root.explanation: Kew release 4.0 notes specify rooting using gymnosperm outgroups; the supplied serialization root is retained. https://sftp.kew.org/pub/paftol/releases/4.0/kew_tree_of_life_release_notes_4.0.txt

changes: Explicit selected-taxon projection/collapse and nonmetric drawing; source bytes unchanged.
limitations: Nonmetric cladogram: depth and connector length do not encode time, evolutionary distance or confidence.
Stroke contacts use tolerance-bounded arc subdivision, finite-width envelopes and clipped local junction neighbourhoods; nonlocal self-contact is checked.
Issue totals are complete only for completed categories; bounded examples do not limit totals. Label totals count label pairs plus once per label that meets any stroke.
Computational checks do not establish biological support or usability for authors.

validationMethodDefinition.specification: compound_scene_validation_v3: retain compound v2 geometry checks and its 500000-operation ceiling. Attachment tests return attached, detached or incomplete. Track incidence completeness independently before stroke/label checks; incidencePassed requires completed attachment checks with no detected failure. Truncation never asserts incidence success or fabricates a detached attachment. Preserve compound v1/v2 implementations for exact saved replay.
limitations: Numerical validation with explicit bounds and work-limit disclosure; no mathematical nonintersection proof, biological peer review or classroom validation.
